y-m-25-08.title: Side sikwazi ukuthemba ulingano y=−5x+200 kangakanani?
y-m-25-08.topic: Uluhlu apho imodeli yomsebenzi womgca isebenza khona: xa imeko itshintsha, ulingano nalo luyatshintsha
y-m-25-08.goal: Hlola uluhlu neemeko apho ulingano lomsebenzi womgca lusebenza khona, uze uqonde ukuba ulingano lunokutshintsha xa imeko itshintsha, ulungise ugwebo lwakho ngolwazi olutsha.
y-m-25-08.material: Xa uvula ivalvu yokukhupha itanki ebambe i-200 L yamanzi, amanzi ayaphuma nge-5 L ngomzuzu. Biza umzuzu wokuvulwa kwevalvu ngokuthi yimizuzu eyi-0, uze wenze isixa samanzi esishiyekileyo kwitanki emva kwemizuzu ngu-x sibe yi-y L. Jonga imizuzu eyi-0 ukuya kwimizuzu engama-60. Amanzi asetankini awanakuhla ngaphantsi kwe-0 L.

y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kuseleyo amanzi amangaphi kwitanki emva kwemizuzu engama-30?
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.after: y = −5×30 + 200 = 50 L. Lixabiso elingaphakathi koluhlu apho ulingano lusebenza khona (0 ≤ x ≤ 40).
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Faka ixesha kulingano wafumana isixa esishiyekileyo.

y-m-25-06.title: Ukuba iindawo ziyafana, ingaba imithambeka iyafana nayo?
y-m-25-06.topic: Unxantathu ojikelezwe yigrafu yomsebenzi womgca nee-axis ezimbini: indawo efanayo, imithambeka eyahlukileyo
y-m-25-06.goal: Gatya ukuqukumbela okuthi 'ukuba iindawo ziyafana, imithambeka iyafana' ngomzekelo ochasayo, uze ubale ukuba isigqibo sitshintsha njani xa imeko itshintshwa.
y-m-25-06.material: Kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa kukho umgca one-x-intercept a ne-y-intercept b (a no-b ngamanani angengawo-0). Lo mgca udlula kumachaphazelo (a, 0) kunye (0, b) yaye wenza unxantathu kunye ne-x-axis ne-y-axis. Indawo yalo nxantathu isisiqingatha sesiphumo sexabiso eliphelele lika-a nexabiso eliphelele lika-b. UHyeonu uthi, 'Imigca eyenza oonxantathu abanendawo efanayo kunye nee-axis ezimbini inomthambeka ofanayo nayo.'

y-m-25-03.title: Ikhweshini edlula kuwo omabini amachaphaza: singayithemba?

y-m-25-04.title: Nokuba ikhweshini ezimbini zijongeka zahlukile, ingaba kukho isisombululo esinye kuphela?
y-m-25-04.topic: Izisombululo zeekhweshini ezidibeneyo ezilinganayo nezindawo zemigca emibini (isisombululo esinye, akukho, ezingenasiphelo)
y-m-25-04.goal: Qonda ukuba iikhweshini ezimbini ezilinganayo ezijongeka zahlukile zinokuba ngumgca ofanayo, hlela iimeko apho inani lezisombululo lixhomekeke kwinto engatshintshiyo, uze wenze iikhweshini zomgca ofanayo ngokwakho.
y-m-25-04.material: Kwiikhweshini ezidibeneyo, ikhweshini elinganayo ax+by=c inokuzotywa njengomgca kwiplani yamakhowudinethi (a no-b abazizo zombini ngu-0). Ukuba imigca emibini idibana kwichaphaza elinye, kukho ibini elinye lezisombululo; ukuba ayidibani, akukho sisombululo; kwaye ukuba igqubana ngokupheleleyo, zikho izisombululo ezingenasiphelo. Ibini (x, y) eyanelisa zombini ikhweshini libizwa ngokuba sisisombululo seekhweshini ezidibeneyo.
y-m-25-04.prereq.0: Ukubona izisombululo zekhweshini elinganayo ax+by=c njengamachaphaza kwiplani yamakhowudinethi
y-m-25-04.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yethambeka nendawo yokunqumla i-y yomgca
y-m-25-04.s.s1.prompt: Zingaphi iibini (x, y) ezanelisa zombini ikhweshini yokuqala 2x − y = −1 (ifundwa ngokuvakalayo: 2x ukuthabatha y kulingana ne-negative 1) nekhweshini yesibini 4x − 2y = −2?
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kwakhona ikhweshini nganye kwifom y = (ithambeka)x + (indawo yokunqumla i-y) uze uzibhale macala ngamacala.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x = 0 no-x = 1 kuzo zombini ikhweshini, ufumane amaxabiso ka-y, uze uwathelekise.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.a: Kukho ibini elinye kuphela. Kuba ikhweshini ezimbini zineefom ezahlukeneyo
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba ukuba ikhweshini zijongeka zahlukile, ngemigca eyahlukileyo.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.b: Akukho bini. Kuba imigca emibini inethambeka elifanayo, ngoko iyafana
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.b: Ujonge kuphela ukuba amathambeka alingana wangayithelekisi indawo zokunqumla i-y.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.c: Zininzi ezingenasiphelo. Kuba ikhweshini ezimbini zimele umgca ofanayo
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuba nokuba ukubonakala kuyahluka, zinokuba ngumgca ofanayo.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuba wahlula macala omabini e-4x − 2y = −2 ngo-2, ufumana u-2x − y = −1. Ikhweshini ezimbini ngumgca ofanayo, ngoko ichaphaza ngalinye kumgca sisisombululo.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.prompt: Gcina ikhweshini yokuqala njengoko injalo, uze utshintshe ikhweshini yesibini ibe yi-4x − 2y = c (c yinto engatshintshiyo). Inani lezisombululo litshintsha njani ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lika-c?
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka amanani ambalwa (umzekelo, −2, 0, 4) endaweni ka-c uthelekise iindawo zokunqumla i-y zemigca emibini.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wahlula iimeko apho imigca emibini inethambeka elifanayo kwezo ezinendawo yokunqumla i-y efanayo nezo ezinendawo yokunqumla i-y eyahlukileyo.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.a: Nokuba c yintoni, zikho izisombululo ezingenasiphelo. Kuba iikoyifishenti ziyafana
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.a: Ujonge kuphela iikoyifishenti zekhweshini wangayicingi ilungu elingatshintshiyo c.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.b: Kuphela kwi-c enye kukho izisombululo ezingenasiphelo, kwaye kwezinye akukho sisombululo
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.b: Ubone ukuba xa c itshintsha, umgca uhamba ngokuhambelana.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.c: Kuphela kwi-c enye akukho sisombululo, kwaye kwezinye i-c kukho ibini elinye ngalinye
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.c: Ucinge ukuba ukuba amathambeka alingana, imigca idibana kuzo zonke iimeko.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.d: Ukuba c ayingo-0, kukho ibini elinye rhoqo, kwaye ukuba ingu-0, akukho
y-m-25-04.s.s2.explain: 4x − 2y = c yi-y = 2x − c/2, kwaye ikhweshini yokuqala yi-y = 2x + 1. Amathambeka ayafana, ngoko ngumgca ofanayo kuphela xa c = −2, kwaye kwezinye i-c ziyafana kwaye azigqubani, ngoko akukho sisombululo.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.prompt: Yenza ikhweshini yesibini ax + by = c emele umgca ofanayo nekhweshini yokuqala 2x − y = −1. Ukuze ukubonakala kungafani, a akufuneki ibe ngu-2, uze ungenise ikhweshini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo njenge-(a, b, c).
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala iikoyifishenti 2, −1, −1 zekhweshini yokuqala uzibeke macala ngamacala no-a, b, c wekhweshini yesibini.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba ikhweshini ezimbini zidlula kumachaphaza afanayo xa x = 0 nalapho y = 0.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Umlinganiselo weekoyifishenti ze-x ne-y ufana nowekhweshini yokuqala, ngoko ithambeka liyafana.

y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c2: Ilungu elingatshintshiyo lisemlinganisweni ofanayo nalo, ngoko imigca iyagqubana.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Umlinganiselo weekoyifishenti uchanekile kodwa ilungu elingatshintshiyo alisemlinganisweni, ngoko ngumgca owahlukileyo ofanayo.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c3: a ngu-2 okanye ngu-0. Ukubonakala kwayo kufana nekhweshini yokuqala, okanye ayenzi mgca.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.explain: Umzekelo: (4, −2, −2), (−2, 1, 1), (6, −3, −3). Ukuba amanani amathathu ekhweshini yesibini ngamanani amathathu (2, −1, −1) ekhweshini yokuqala aphindaphindwe ngenani elifanayo, ikhweshini ezimbini ngumgca ofanayo. Ukuba nenani elinye lisuka kuloo mlinganiselo, akungomgca ofanayo.

y-m-25-05.title: Ngaba onenani lethambeka elikhulu ukhawuleza?
y-m-25-05.topic: Ukufunda ithambeka legrafu: ukuthelekisa iigrafu ezimbini ezineeyunithi ezahlukeneyo
y-m-25-05.goal: Qonda ukuba ithambeka kufuneka lifundwe kunye neeyunithi zalo, uze uthelekise iigrafu ezimbini ezineeyunithi ezahlukeneyo ngokuzinyusa zibe yeyunithi efanayo.
y-m-25-05.material: UDoyun noSeoa nganye uhambile wazoba iirekhodi zabo njengegrafu. Igrafu kaDoyun inexesha (imizuzu) kwi-eksisi ethe tye nomgama ohanjiweyo (m) kwi-eksisi ethe nkqo, kwaye ngumgca othe ngqo odlula kwimvelaphi (0, 0) nechaphaza (10, 700). Igrafu kaSeoa inexesha (iiyure) kwi-eksisi ethe tye nomgama ohanjiweyo (km) kwi-eksisi ethe nkqo, kwaye ngumgca othe ngqo odlula kwimvelaphi nechaphaza (2, 10).

y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kwigrafu nganye, thi i-eksisi ethe nkqo inyuka kangakanani xa i-eksisi ethe tye inyuka nge-1, kunye neyunithi.

y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.b: Uthelekise ubukhulu bamanani kuphela ungahlolanga iiyunithi.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.c: Okukhona umthambeka mncinci, kokukhona ugqiba umgama ofanayo kwangethuba, ngoko uSeoa ukhawuleza ngakumbi
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.c: Ucinge ubudlelwane phakathi komthambeka nesantya ngokuphindaphindeneyo.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.explain: Umthambeka sisixa i-axis ethe nkqo enyuka ngaso xa i-axis ethe tye inyuka nge-1. UDoyun uhamba i-70 m ngomzuzu yaye uSeoa uhamba i-5 km ngeyure, ngoko ukuba iiyunithi ziyahluka, azinakuthelekiswa ngamanani kuphela.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba utshintsha ukuhamba kukaDoyun kube ziiyunithi ezifanayo nezegrafu kaSeoa (iiyure kwi-axis ethe tye, ii-km kwi-axis ethe nkqo), uDoyun uhamba d km kwiiyure ezingu-t. Faka izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo (t, d) ezihambelana nobu budlelwane. Kodwa, 0 < t ≤ 3.
